AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM – TROUBLESHOOTING

Blinking Light LO HI Air Outlet Damper Position Sensor Circuit

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

This sensor detects the position of the air mix
damper and sends the appropriate signals to the
A/C amplifier.
The position sensor is built into the air outlet
damper control servo motor assembly.

HI    Air outlet damper position sensor value does
not change even if A/C amplifier signals the air
outlet damper control servo motor to move.
